0.1.0.name: com.123cy321.nontoon-converter
0.1.0.description: lilToon -> NonToon material converter, shipped as a companion package to NonToon (Fork) so that the shader package stays a pure library. Generates NEW materials and never modifies the original lilToon materials. VRChat's PipelineManager is accessed through reflection, so this package has no VRChat SDK dependency and also works in non-VRChat projects.
